faq_heading: Homes near Holly Elementary in Delta: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Holly Elementary in Delta catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Delta School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Holly Elementary in Delta home search find homes?
faq.a: By name: a listing shows up when its description mentions Holly Elementary in Delta. Ask Jared to watch for nearby homes that leave the school out.

faq.q: How much do homes near Holly Elementary in Delta sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 42 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,338,000, townhomes $860,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Holly Elementary in Delta?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Holly Elementary in Delta the median was 16 days on the market, closing at 96.8% of the list price, with 12% of sales above the list price for the 42 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Holly Elementary in Delta?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Delta Access (0.8 km west), Hawthorne Elementary (1.7 km north-west) and Delta Christian School (1.7 km west).

How the Holly Elementary in Delta search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Holly Elementary in Delta, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Holly Elementary in Delta

7 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Holly Elementary in Delta in a straight line (5 elementary, 2 secondary; 2 independent). The closest is Delta Access, 0.8 km away, and the farthest on this list is Neilson Grove Elementary, 2.5 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Hawthorne Elementary (1.7 km); the nearest independent school is Delta Christian School (1.7 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Ladner Elementary (2.5 km). Other elementary schools close by: Hawthorne Elementary (1.7 km north-west), Delta Christian School (1.7 km west), Sacred Heart (2.3 km south-west), Ladner Elementary (2.5 km west), Neilson Grove Elementary (2.5 km north-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Hawthorne Elementary, 1.7 km north-west of Holly Elementary in Delta.
